# Auseklis: computed results (generated by `python -m auseklis.report`; all CALCULATED from ASSUMED inputs)

## Reference orbit

- Sun-synchronous inclination at 550 km: **97.59 deg** (requirement 97.6 deg)
- Circular speed 7585 m/s, period 95.6 min, eclipse (beta=0) 35.6 min
- Drag Δv to hold 550 km: 0.57 / 2.04 / 12.48 m/s per year (solar min / moderate / max, Cd A/m = 0.0125 m²/kg, ASSUMED density table, expect a factor ~2-3 uncertainty)
- Hohmann 550→570 km: 10.9 m/s; plane change of 1 deg: 132 m/s (so a 500 m/s budget cannot buy more than ~3.9 deg of plane change)

- RAAN gap closure by altitude drift: ±20 km gives 0.010 deg/day, so 1 deg takes 101 days; ±50 km gives 0.025 deg/day. **Targets must already be in (nearly) the servicer's plane.**
